add_heuristics.action: read it as open child work, not as a failure
show it on the walk; the parent waits for the operator's retry or cancel

add_decision_rules.name: Expansion appends
add_decision_rules.condition: a branch discovered during a walk needs steps
add_decision_rules.outcome: capture it, close its capability gaps once, append a step for it with the next unused index depending on the discovering step, re-run the jurisdiction full gate and the simulation over the new plan, and leave existing indices and positions where they are

add_decision_rules.name: The AMT is a new version
add_decision_rules.outcome: write the AMT as a new version before the queue is consumed and keep the old body; a failed write pauses with the queue intact

add_decision_rules.name: Open children gate completion
add_decision_rules.condition: a walk's steps are done but descendants are open
add_decision_rules.outcome: park the task as awaiting children, deliver the response, and release it automatically when the last blocker completes; completed stays final

add_decision_rules.name: What does not gate
add_decision_rules.condition: gap checklists, queued re-expansion candidates or a cancelled node exist
add_decision_rules.outcome: do not let them block completion; a failed child parks visibly until the operator retries it as a new task under the same parent or cancels it
